<function name="SetFont" parent="DTextEntry" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Changes the font of the DTextEntry.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="font" type="string">The name of the font to be changed to.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Restores the original font the the DTextEntry.</description>
	<code>
local textentry = vgui.Create("DTextEntry")
textentry:SetFont("DermaDefault")
	</code>

</example>
